resume_protocol: Before any S10 action, inspect the single-writer lock holder, actor process, S10 receipt, finalized files, and partial files.
Never rerun S01-S09; they are already content-addressed closed segments.
If an S10 actor owns the lock, do not restart, terminate, or duplicate it merely because SSH/tool transport returned an error.
If an actor exits and a receipt exists, adjudicate that receipt before any further transport action.
If an actor exits without a receipt, verify frozen finalized files and partial bytes against the existing manifest before using only the already-authorized resumable transport path.
Transport-only retry remains bounded by the existing human materialization authority and may not alter task/episode selection or frozen file identity.

No model/checkpoint weight download, model load, GPU execution, training, policy rollout, policy outcome read, task replacement, episode replacement, or claim expansion is authorized by this checkpoint.
